name: Transfer between own accounts
what_goes_here: Money moving between the business's own bank, savings or card accounts. Not income or expense.

name: Equipment and fixed assets
what_goes_here: Items over the capitalization threshold ($2,500 in this benchmark, the IRS de minimis safe harbor amount without an audited financial statement).

name: Credit card payment
what_goes_here: Paying the business credit card bill from the bank account. The charges were already expensed on the card.

name: Sales tax payment
what_goes_here: Remitting sales tax collected from customers.

name: Loan payment
what_goes_here: A payment on a loan or equipment financing. Needs a split between principal and interest.

name: Owner contribution
what_goes_here: Money the owner puts into the business.

name: Owner draw or distribution
what_goes_here: Money the owner takes out, including personal estimated tax payments made from a pass-through business account.

name: Revenue
what_goes_here: Sales and service income, including card processor and marketplace payouts and insurance reimbursements.

name: Refunds to customers
what_goes_here: Money returned to customers. A contra-revenue account.

name: Cost of goods and materials
what_goes_here: Inventory, ingredients, materials and supplies used to make what is sold.

name: Subcontractors
what_goes_here: Outside workers paid per job.

name: Fuel (cost of revenue)
what_goes_here: Fuel for a business whose revenue is moving things: trucking and freight.

name: Wages
what_goes_here: Employee net pay.

name: Payroll taxes and fees
what_goes_here: Payroll tax debits and payroll service fees.

name: Rent
what_goes_here: Rent for premises.

name: Utilities
what_goes_here: Power, gas, water, trash.

name: Meals
what_goes_here: Business meals. Deductibility limits are applied at tax time, not here.

name: Travel
what_goes_here: Airfare, hotels, rideshare and car rental while traveling.

name: Vehicle and fuel
what_goes_here: Fuel and vehicle costs for a business that isn't in transport.

name: Professional fees
what_goes_here: Accounting, legal and consulting.

name: Taxes and licenses
what_goes_here: Business licenses, registrations and non-income business taxes.

name: Lab and clinical supplies
what_goes_here: Clinical supplies for a healthcare practice that are consumed rather than resold.

name: Ask the client
what_goes_here: The bank line alone can't say what this is (a Venmo or Zelle to a person, a cash withdrawal). The right answer is to ask.
